the design of time modulated linear antenna arrays for ultra-low side lobes using an ecologically inspired meta heuristic algorithm.
the synthesis of linear antenna arrays with time modulation using an enhanced version of the Invasive Weed Optimization metaheuristic algorithm.
the synthesis of linear antenna arrays with the lowest SLL, SBL and BWFN.

the proposed IWO algorithm is a very efficient and effective metaheuristic for time-modulated antenna array synthesis.
the proposed algorithm is able to achieve better results than the existing algorithms for the design of time modulated linear antenna array.
the proposed modified IWO algorithm can be a potential tool to solve the real-valued parameter optimization problems related to time-modulated antenna array synthesis.

the IWO is a powerful tool for solving complex real parameter optimization problems.
